note: Regulatory policy dashboard: policies carry a type, status, a transparent relevance score and an estimated compliance cost; a PolicyMetric child gives each policy a small year-by-year history (related data on the detail page, and its own chart); a dashboard visualises cost by policy, status mix and cost by year, filterable and sortable by type, date and relevance.

Policy.message: Relevance score must be between 0 and 100

Policy.title: Clean Air Standards Update
Policy.summary: Tightens emission limits for industrial facilities burning fossil fuels, phased in over three years, with monitoring and public reporting requirements.

Policy.title: Consumer Financial Protection Rule
Policy.summary: Restricts predatory lending practices and requires plain-language disclosure of fees on consumer credit products.

Policy.title: Workplace Safety Modernization Act
Policy.summary: Updates workplace injury reporting thresholds and mandates annual safety training for high-risk occupations.

Policy.title: Cross-Border Trade Tariff Adjustment
Policy.summary: Proposes adjusted tariffs on imported steel and aluminum to address dumping complaints from domestic producers.

Policy.title: Healthcare Data Privacy Extension
Policy.summary: Extends existing patient data privacy protections to telehealth providers and third-party health apps that process patient records.

Policy.title: Renewable Energy Incentive Repeal
Policy.summary: Repealed a tax-credit program for residential renewable energy installations after the program reached its funding cap.

Policy.list.title: Policies
Policy.list.intro: Browse, filter and sort regulatory policies.

pages.title: About this dashboard
pages.heading: Regulatory policy tracker
body: This dashboard tracks regulatory policies across agencies: their status, relevance and estimated compliance cost, with a year-by-year history for the policies that have one.

dashboards.title: Policy analytics
dashboards.intro: Compliance cost, status mix and year-over-year trends across all tracked policies.
